description: This file defines a Go struct and associated methods for configuring label selectors in Kubernetes apply configurations. It includes functions for setting match labels and match expressions, used for declarative resource management.

classes.name: LabelSelectorApplyConfiguration
classes.description: A struct representing a declarative configuration for Kubernetes label selectors, including matchLabels and matchExpressions.

methods.name: LabelSelector
methods.description: Constructor function that creates a new instance of LabelSelectorApplyConfiguration.

methods.name: WithMatchLabels
methods.description: Sets the matchLabels map in the configuration, overwriting existing entries with the same keys.

methods.name: WithMatchExpressions
methods.description: Appends label selector requirements to the matchExpressions list in the configuration.
